title: Fix Arc Preview and Output
description: The arc command doesn't preview correctly (no curve rendering for arc/circle-outline preview kinds) and produces wrong output (kernel reads radiusPoint instead of start)
summary: Generalized virtual file system with FileNodeKind, DescriptorKind (text, time, avatar), FileNode.fileNodeKindId + descriptorValues, schema-driven table columns. Updated ui/react VirtualFileSystem, framework/platform/core models and controller getSchema(), sketchpad VFS, platform renderer, and Storybook.
